node.title: E_3 calculus: the 3-fold exchange energy + the structured lower-bound direction
node.statement: Define E_3(u,v) = the 3-fold iterated exchange correlation (odd-order Johnson-scheme sum; E_2 = averaged_xr). Prove the EASY direction of the inverse: folded/equivariant words and tangent pairs have E_3 large (explicit lower bounds). Consistency check: E_2 reproduces the averaged-XR variance.
node.notes: E2 scaffold caveat (PR #184): frozen full-block quotient fibers have ZERO one-exchange energy — the inverse test MUST strip paid quotient strata first or use a multi-exchange variant, else designed-in false negative. Structured >> random baseline confirmed on the walk-energy proxy. | DELIVERED (#184 retitled 'prove XR exchange-energy calculus'): flips on integration.
